- See also.

RESULTS template structure: how-to header, repo HEAD table for study-tutor / jarvis / specialist-agent / nats-core / fleet-gateway plus image tags, Outcome line (✅/⏸/❌), Demo blocking? line, deltas vs prior run, Phase × Gate × Outcome × Evidence summary table mirroring the runbook, Bug catalogue (same four-field shape), What's working narrative, Next steps fix-and-rerun list, hygiene flags, evidence index.

Same for the Reference Bug #4 worked example.

No Python code, tests, or production source touched — pure documentation, so AC-005 (no lint/format violations) holds trivially.
